title: Decoding Diffusion: A Scalable Framework for Unsupervised Analysis of Latent Space Biases and Representations Using Natural Language Prompts

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the cosine distance in the diffusion model's intermediate latent space (h-space) between representations of explicitly gendered prompts and gender-neutral prompts across different professions and physical attributes (e.g., hairstyles), and validating these latent distances using CLIP-based gender classification on the generated images.
